text: Work that runs past one job. Each step is done in its own act, and a step still undone when its act ends is gone for good.

quests.name: The miner's debt
quests.blurb: Con-Reg holds the paper on eleven years of your boots. Lose the paper, and the Company has to find you the hard way.

steps.next: Rook's job, on the board: lose your file from Depot 4's terminal.
steps.said: Your file is gone from Depot 4. Con-Reg will find the paper again, but not this month.

steps.next: Con-Reg's courier, with your paper filed again: marked on the chart.

place.name: Con-Reg claims tender
place.text: A Con-Reg claims tender at the system's edge, logging the colony for the Company's lawyers. Recovery crews her.

steps.next: Con-Reg's claims tender, within reach of the colony: Recovery holds her.

payoff.said: The tender's log had the colony in it. It doesn't now: Con-Reg has to find you the hard way, and its raids come half as often.

quests.name: The deserter's pardon
quests.blurb: The Provost has a warrant with your name on it. Lose the warrant, square it with your old ship, and the Provost has nothing to go on.

steps.next: Mother Ilse's job, on the board: lose your warrant in the Provost's filing.
steps.said: Your warrant is in the wrong drawer under the wrong name. The Provost will find it, eventually.

steps.next: The Resolute, your old tender, short of spares: marked on the chart.

place.name: Provost courier
place.text: A Provost courier cutter at the system's edge, your file in her safe and the colony's bearing in her log.

steps.next: The Provost's courier, within reach of the colony: her MPs hold her.

payoff.said: Your file and the courier's log go into the colony's furnace. The Provost starts over from nothing, and its raids come half as often.

quests.name: The smuggler's cargo
quests.blurb: Forty crates of the Hallorans' went out your airlock. Bring them back, crate by crate, and square it with the family.

steps.next: Ferris's job, on the board: eleven of the crates, out of the customs pound.
steps.said: Eleven crates back in Halloran hands. Old Halloran sends word that it's a start.

steps.next: The other twenty-nine crates, adrift where you dumped them: marked on the chart.

place.name: Halloran runner
place.text: A Halloran runner at the family's drop, her collectors come for the interest on forty crates.

steps.next: The Hallorans' runner at their drop, within reach of the colony: their collectors hold her.

payoff.said: The collectors fly home in their lifeboat with word for Old Halloran: paid in full. He'll take it, this once, and the family's raids come half as often.

quests.name: The tender's stores
quests.blurb: Pirates took the Fleet tender's stores pod. Bring it home, and the Fleet remembers who did.

steps.next: The tender's stolen stores pod: marked on the chart, from the next sector on. Her bosun would sign on, given a berth.

quests.name: The hall's food run
quests.blurb: A striking hall's food run is a pilot short. Fly it, and the union remembers who did.

steps.next: The hall's food run: marked on the chart, from the next sector on. Its steward would sign on, given a berth.

quests.name: The surveyor's lifepod
quests.blurb: The surveyor who logged your tow honestly was let go for it. Con-Reg put her out at the lanes in a lifepod.

steps.next: The surveyor's lifepod: marked on the chart, from the next sector on. She would sign on, given a berth.

quests.name: The family's runner
quests.blurb: A Halloran runner limps home on one engine, and her medic would rather not go with her.

steps.next: The family's runner: marked on the chart, from the next sector on. Her medic would sign on, given a berth.

quests.name: Varga's tender
quests.blurb: The pirates who cut the tender's stores pod open are laid up somewhere past the charts. Varga would like a word with them.

place.name: Pirate cutter
place.text: The cutter that cut the Fleet tender's stores pod open, laid up past the charts with the tender's rations still in her hold. Varga knows her by her burn marks.

steps.next: The pirates who took the tender's stores, within reach of the colony.

payoff.said: The tender's rations go home to the Fleet, in a manner of speaking. Varga calls you skipper now, and means it.

quests.name: Teo's list
quests.blurb: The strikebreakers who broke Pier Nine hire out to claims past the charts now. Teo has kept a list of their names.

place.name: Strikebreakers' tug
place.text: The tug that brought the strikebreakers to Pier Nine, hired out to the claims past the charts. Teo has a list of the names aboard.

steps.next: The strikebreakers' tug from Pier Nine, within reach of the colony.

payoff.said: Teo crosses the last names off his list and folds it away. The local back home hears about it by the next mail.

quests.name: Ama's survey chief
quests.blurb: The survey chief who let Ama go is staking this system for the Company. His guards don't know her. He does.

place.name: Survey chief's tug
place.text: Chief Surveyor Harl's tug, staking the colony's system for the Company. His guards don't know Ama. He does, and he signed her papers.

steps.next: Ama's old survey chief, staking the system for the Company, within reach of the colony.

payoff.said: Harl's claim stakes go out the airlock with his survey log. Ama files her own, honestly, in triplicate, with the colony's name on it.

quests.name: Dez's homecoming
quests.blurb: The family has sent the collectors to bring Dez home for Old Halloran's birthday, whatever Dez says about it.

place.name: Family runner
place.text: A Halloran runner come to take Dez home for Old Halloran's birthday, her collectors with a cake and a warrant of the family's own.

steps.next: The family's runner, come to take Dez home, within reach of the colony.

payoff.said: The collectors fly home without him, and with the cake. Dez sends the old man a card, and stays.
